_README: ENTRY STAGE: major declaration in the School of Engineering (Prompt 08 B1).

First-year students are in curriculum 004 and declare a major later. A SoE major's OWN courses are labelled 'after major declaration' until a verified declaration record exists (StudentAcademicEvidence kind 'admission', key 'soe-major-declaration'). The plan never assumes the declaration.
No entry requirements are encoded: the archived catalog states none for declaration, and the SoE declaration policy page returned HTTP 403 to a plain GET. Unknown, not 'none'.

sources.note: HTTP 403 to a plain GET on 2026-11-11: open evidence gap.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Students declare a major after the first-year program (curriculum 004).
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: The stage itself is modeled (labels); its timing and any prerequisites are on soe.rutgers.edu (HTTP 403) and remain unknown.
rules_not_yet_modeled.quote: Students in the first year of a four-year curriculum are listed under curriculum code 004.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Students complete the prescribed program of study in their DECLARED major.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: Modeled: each SoE major's own nodes come after this stage (program_version.admission_stage).
rules_not_yet_modeled.quote: Students must complete a prescribed program of study in their declared major

unknowns: Declaration timing, deadlines and any minimum grades/GPA (soe.rutgers.edu declaring-major page, HTTP 403).
